headline: Executive order directs federal action to grow Registered Apprenticeship programs in industry and government and to promote labor-management forums.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order aims to expand the use of Registered Apprenticeships, which are formal, government-recognized programs that combine paid work with job training. It covers apprenticeships in private industries and within the federal government itself. It also promotes labor-management forums, which are meetings where federal agency leaders and employee unions discuss workplace issues. No summary was provided, so specific requirements and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Job seekers and workers interested in apprenticeships
who_it_affects.how: They may see more Registered Apprenticeship openings that offer paid on-the-job training.
They are directed to take steps to expand apprenticeships and support labor-management forums.
They may take part in labor-management forums with agency leaders.
They may be encouraged to start or grow Registered Apprenticeship programs.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 6, 2024; executive orders generally take effect when signed.
